newsitem.title: USA: Niagara Mohawk seeks another extension.
newsitem.headline: Niagara Mohawk seeks another extension.

text.p: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp said Wednesday it requested an eighth 30-day extension of the company's 1997 rate request proceedings.
The previous extension was to have expired February 20.
The latest extension request would postpone filing of staff and intervener testimony until March 21 and the effective date of the requested rate increase until October 22, the company said.
It said the New York Public Service Commission staff has indicated that it will support the extension.
Niagara Mohawk said it continues to focus on negotiations with independent power producers.
If an agreement is reached in those negotiations, the need for the rate case might be eliminated, it noted.
